678-4022-4247.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-4247.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

339-677-5295-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-5295-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-7208-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7208-8201.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3490-4478-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4478-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6495-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6495-6719.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6719.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1417-2738-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2459-3184-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1013-3713-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Hypervolt Grasp by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-5330-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4499-7057-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

261-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

661-3375-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to The Immortal Sun. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1806-2060-2445-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

222-527-997-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3991-5231-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

225-539-751-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 3.
225-539-751-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
225-539-751-4249.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

3490-3755-4927-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-5708.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-5708.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1575-4231-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-5089-6745.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-5089-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2821-5089-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Karn, the Great Creator.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1171-4785.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-4785.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1117-1594-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-4881-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Gix.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Activated Sleeper and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

509-1267-1379-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1379-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

710-2034-2386-2579.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Danitha.
710-2034-2386-2579.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Danitha on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Danitha from your library onto the battlefield.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

876-1308-2034-2703.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator tokens.

1543-2311-2369.notablePrerequisites: The number of creatures you control plus two times the number of other planeswalkers you control is at least eleven.
1543-2311-2369.description:
Activate Huatli's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting an additional loyalty counter on it for each creature you control.
If necessary, activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to put a loyalty counter on Huatli.
Repeat step 2 until Huatli has at least thirteen loyalty.
Activate Huatli by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

553-4105.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Demonic Tutor by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it into your hand.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

777-1456-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

745-3492-3499-3609.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Ghastly Mimicry triggers, creating a token copy of Coretapper.
Activate the Coretapper token's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate the Coretapper token's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
If desired, activate the first ability of any untapped Coretappers you control by tapping them, putting charge counters on any artifacts.
Repeat each turn.
